```python
# Boardings by hub group: a station's platforms add up under one name.
calls = after.transit_calls().to_pandas()
names = pd.DataFrame(transit.stops()).set_index("stop_id")["name"]
calls["stop"] = calls["stop_id"].map(names)
by_hub = calls.groupby("hub_group").agg(name=("stop", "first"), boardings=("boardings", "sum"))
by_hub.sort_values("boardings", ascending=False).head(5)
```
